infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: DextroHeart connects to the ECG/SCG sensor patch via Bluetooth to stream 14-lead cardiac data.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: DextroHeart connects to the ECG/SCG sensor patch via Bluetooth.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DextroHeart uses the camera for ultrasound image capture via the attached transducer.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DextroHeart uses the microphone to capture phonocardiogram (PCG) audio from the sternal sensor.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: DextroHeart may read heart rate and ECG data from HealthKit for comparison and trending.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: DextroHeart may save ECG session summaries to HealthKit.
